entries.dialogueText: "I must say it makes me proud to see you in that seat. Between your time on this council and the fine work you did in Valenqiris, I can't think of a better man for the position."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Your Majesty. It is a pleasure and..."

entries.dialogueText: "I must say it makes me proud to see you in that seat. If you show the same devotion as you did on King Valero's council, you'll make a fine ruler."

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, welcome, Your Majesty. If you're half the young man your father made you out to be, you'll make a fine king."

entries.title: Elena Werner: ""For Dast's sake, Laurento, you don..."
entries.dialogueText: "For Dast's sake, Laurento, you don't need to hold the door open for me every single time. I'm not as fragile as I look."

entries.title: Narrator: "I remembered their flirtatious rout..."

entries.dialogueText: I was about to be inundated with updates and reports from my councilors -- I only hoped I could keep it all straight.

entries.dialogueText: "The son of a traitor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "You're the traitor's son."

entries.dialogueText: "I wanted to introduce myself before our first official meeting."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "I don't know what you've heard. But I assure you that's not my aim."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I-- well, in a nutshell, yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "I-- well, in a nutshell, yes."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I may be the leader of the opposit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I may be the leader of the opposition, but I'm not your enemy. If you and I establish a dialogue, I believe we can work wonders for this country."
